scripts.dev:api: pnpm --filter @trissea/api build && node scripts/run-local.mjs foundation --watch services/api/dist/main.js
scripts.test: pnpm test:client && pnpm test:mobile:session && pnpm --filter @trissea/api test && node --test tests/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:m2:integration: pnpm --filter @trissea/api exec tsc && pnpm test:client && pnpm test:mobile:session && node --test scripts/test-m2-integration.mjs
scripts.test:m2:browser: pnpm --filter @trissea/api exec tsc && pnpm test:client && pnpm test:mobile:session && node --test scripts/test-m2-browser.mjs
scripts.validate: pnpm contracts:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.test:identity:db: pnpm --filter @trissea/api exec tsc && node scripts/run-local.mjs test --test scripts/test-identity-database.mjs
scripts.test:authorization:db: pnpm --filter @trissea/api exec tsc && node scripts/run-local.mjs test --test scripts/test-authorization-database.mjs
scripts.test:passenger:auth: pnpm --filter @trissea/api exec tsc && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run-local.mjs test --test scripts/test-passenger-auth.mjs
scripts.test:driver:auth: pnpm --filter @trissea/api exec tsc && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.test.json && node scripts/run-local.mjs test --test scripts/test-driver-auth.mjs
scripts.passenger:prepare: pnpm --filter @trissea/api build && node scripts/run-local.mjs test scripts/prepare-passenger-local.mjs
scripts.driver:prepare: pnpm --filter @trissea/api build && node scripts/run-local.mjs test scripts/prepare-passenger-local.mjs --driver
scripts.admin:prepare: pnpm --filter @trissea/api build && node scripts/run-local.mjs admin scripts/prepare-admin-database.mjs
scripts.test:verification: pnpm --filter @trissea/api exec tsc && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.test.json && node --test scripts/test-verification.mjs
scripts.dev:admin:identity: node scripts/run-local.mjs admin apps/admin/node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js --config apps/admin/vite.config.ts apps/admin
